abilities.name: 악취
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon's damaging moves have a 10% chance to make the target flinch with each hit if they do not already cause flinching as a secondary effect.

This ability does not stack with a held item.

Overworld: The wild encounter rate is halved while this Pokémon is first in the party.
abilities.shortEffect: Has a 10% chance of making target Pokémon flinch with each hit.
abilities.effectKo: 악취를 풍겨서 공격했을 때 상대가 풀죽을 때가 있다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 악취를 풍겨서 공격했을 때 상대가 풀죽을 때가 있다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 악취를 풍겨서 공격했을 때 상대가 풀죽을 때가 있다.

abilities.name: 잔비
abilities.effect:
The weather changes to rain when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless replaced by another weather condition.

If multiple Pokémon with this ability, drought, sand stream, or snow warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting trick room.  Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
abilities.shortEffect: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
abilities.effectKo: 등장했을 때 날씨를 비로 만든다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 등장했을 때 날씨를 비로 만든다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 등장했을 때 날씨를 비로 만든다.

abilities.name: 가속
abilities.effect: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage after each turn.
abilities.shortEffect: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.
abilities.effectKo: 매 턴 스피드가 올라간다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 매 턴 스피드가 올라간다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 매 턴 스피드가 올라간다.

abilities.name: 전투무장
abilities.effect:
Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon.

This ability functions identically to shell armor.
abilities.shortEffect: Protects against critical hits.
abilities.effectKo: 단단한 껍질에 보호받아 상대의 공격이 급소에 맞지 않는다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 단단한 껍질에 보호받아 상대의 공격이 급소에 맞지 않는다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 단단한 껍질에 보호받아 상대의 공격이 급소에 맞지 않는다.

abilities.name: 옹골참
abilities.effect:
When this Pokémon is at full HP, any hit that would knock it out will instead leave it with 1 HP.  Regardless of its current HP, it is also immune to the one-hit KO moves: fissure, guillotine, horn drill, and sheer cold.

If this Pokémon is holding a focus sash, this ability takes precedence and the item will not be consumed.
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead.  Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.
abilities.effectKo: 상대 기술을 받아도 일격으로 쓰러지지 않는다. 일격필살 기술도 효과 없다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 상대 기술을 받아도 일격으로 쓰러지지 않는다. 일격필살 기술도 효과 없다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 상대 기술을 받아도 일격으로 쓰러지지 않는다. 일격필살 기술도 효과 없다.

abilities.name: 습기
abilities.effect: While this Pokémon is in battle, self destruct and explosion will fail and aftermath will not take effect.
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents self destruct, explosion, and aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.
abilities.effectKo: 주변을 습하게 함으로써 자폭 등 폭발하는 기술을 아무도 못 쓰게 한다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 주변을 습하게 함으로써 자폭 등 폭발하는 기술을 아무도 못 쓰게 한다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 주변을 습하게 함으로써 자폭 등 폭발하는 기술을 아무도 못 쓰게 한다.

abilities.name: 유연
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon cannot be paralyzed.

If a Pokémon is paralyzed and acquires this ability, its paralysis is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents paralysis.
abilities.effectKo: 유연한 몸으로 인해 마비 상태가 되지 않는다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 유연한 몸으로 인해 마비 상태가 되지 않는다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 유연한 몸으로 인해 마비 상태가 되지 않는다.

abilities.name: 모래숨기
abilities.effect:
During a sandstorm, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take sandstorm damage regardless of type.

The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.
abilities.shortEffect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.
abilities.effectKo: 모래바람일 때 회피율이 올라간다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 모래바람일 때 회피율이 올라간다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 모래바람일 때 회피율이 올라간다.

abilities.name: 정전기
abilities.effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed.

Pokémon that are immune to electric-type moves can still be paralyzed by this ability.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, there is a 50% chance that encounters will be with an electric Pokémon, if applicable.
abilities.shortEffect: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.effectKo: 정전기를 몸에 둘러 접촉한 상대를 마비시킬 때가 있다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 정전기를 몸에 둘러 접촉한 상대를 마비시킬 때가 있다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 정전기를 몸에 둘러 접촉한 상대를 마비시킬 때가 있다.

abilities.name: 축전
abilities.effect:
Whenever an electric-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it.

This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves.  Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's substitute.

This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. thunder wave.
abilities.shortEffect: Absorbs electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
abilities.effectKo: 전기타입의 기술을 받으면 데미지를 받지 않고 회복한다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 전기타입의 기술을 받으면 데미지를 받지 않고 회복한다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 전기타입의 기술을 받으면 데미지를 받지 않고 회복한다.

abilities.name: 저수
abilities.effect:
Whenever a water-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it.

Water moves will ignore this Pokémon's substitute.
abilities.shortEffect: Absorbs water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
abilities.effectKo: 물타입의 기술을 받으면 데미지를 받지 않고 회복한다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 물타입의 기술을 받으면 데미지를 받지 않고 회복한다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 물타입의 기술을 받으면 데미지를 받지 않고 회복한다.

abilities.name: 둔감
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon cannot be infatuated and is immune to captivate.

If a Pokémon is infatuated and acquires this ability, its infatuation is cleared.
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents infatuation and protects against captivate.
abilities.effectKo: 둔감해서 헤롱헤롱이나 도발 상태가 되지 않는다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 둔감해서 헤롱헤롱이나 도발 상태가 되지 않는다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 둔감해서 헤롱헤롱이나 도발 상태가 되지 않는다.

abilities.name: 날씨부정
abilities.effect:
While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects.

This ability functions identically to air lock.
abilities.shortEffect: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
abilities.effectKo: 모든 날씨의 영향이 없어진다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 모든 날씨의 영향이 없어진다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 모든 날씨의 영향이 없어진다.

abilities.name: 복안
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their accuracy.

This ability has no effect on the one-hit KO moves (fissure, guillotine, horn drill, and sheer cold).

Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, the chance of a wild Pokémon holding a particular item is raised from 50%, 5%, or 1% to 60%, 20%, or 5%, respectively.
abilities.shortEffect: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.3×.
abilities.effectKo: 복안을 가지고 있어 기술의 명중률이 올라간다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 복안을 가지고 있어 기술의 명중률이 올라간다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 복안을 가지고 있어 기술의 명중률이 올라간다.

abilities.name: 불면
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon cannot be asleep.

This causes rest to fail altogether.  If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

This ability functions identically to vital spirit in battle.
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents sleep.
abilities.effectKo: 잠들지 못하는 체질이라 잠듦 상태가 되지 않는다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 잠들지 못하는 체질이라 잠듦 상태가 되지 않는다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 잠들지 못하는 체질이라 잠듦 상태가 되지 않는다.

abilities.name: 변색
abilities.effect:
Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move, the Pokémon's type changes to match the move.

If the Pokémon has two types, both are overridden.  The Pokémon must directly take damage; for example, moves blocked by a substitute will not trigger this ability, nor will moves that deal damage indirectly, such as spikes.

This ability takes effect on only the last hit of a multiple-hit attack.

In Pokémon Colosseum and XD: Gale of Darkness, this ability does not take effect on Shadow-type moves.
abilities.shortEffect: Changes type to match when hit by a damaging move.
abilities.effectKo: 상대에게 받은 기술의 타입으로 자신의 타입이 변화한다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 상대에게 받은 기술의 타입으로 자신의 타입이 변화한다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 상대에게 받은 기술의 타입으로 자신의 타입이 변화한다.

abilities.name: 면역
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon cannot be poisoned.  This includes bad poison.

If a Pokémon is poisoned and acquires this ability, its poison is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents poison.
abilities.effectKo: 체내에 면역을 가지고 있어 독 상태가 되지 않는다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 체내에 면역을 가지고 있어 독 상태가 되지 않는다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 체내에 면역을 가지고 있어 독 상태가 되지 않는다.

abilities.name: 타오르는불꽃
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon is immune to fire-type moves.  Once this Pokémon has been hit by a Fire move, its own Fire moves will inflict 1.5× as much damage until it leaves battle.

This ability has no effect while the Pokémon is frozen.  The Fire damage bonus is retained even if the Pokémon is frozen and thawed or the ability is lost or disabled.  Fire moves will ignore this Pokémon's substitute.  This ability takes effect even on non-damaging moves, i.e. will o wisp.
abilities.shortEffect: Protects against fire moves.  Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.
abilities.effectKo: 불꽃타입의 기술을 받으면 불꽃을 받아서 자신이 사용하는 불꽃타입의 기술이 강해진다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 불꽃타입의 기술을 받으면 불꽃을 받아서 자신이 사용하는 불꽃타입의 기술이 강해진다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 불꽃타입의 기술을 받으면 불꽃을 받아서 자신이 사용하는 불꽃타입의 기술이 강해진다.

abilities.name: 인분
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon is immune to the extra effects of moves used against it.

An extra effect is a move's chance, listed as an "effect chance", to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect.  For example, thunder shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but thunder wave's is not, nor are knock off's item removal and air cutter's increased critical hit rate.
abilities.shortEffect: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.
abilities.effectKo: 인분에 보호받아 기술의 추가 효과를 받지 않게 된다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 인분에 보호받아 기술의 추가 효과를 받지 않게 된다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 인분에 보호받아 기술의 추가 효과를 받지 않게 된다.

abilities.name: 마이페이스
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon cannot be confused.

If a Pokémon is confused and acquires this ability, its confusion will immediately be healed.
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents confusion.
abilities.effectKo: 마이페이스라서 혼란 상태가 되지 않는다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 마이페이스라서 혼란 상태가 되지 않는다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 마이페이스라서 혼란 상태가 되지 않는다.

abilities.name: 흡반
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon cannot be forced out of battle by moves such as whirlwind.

dragon tail and circle throw still inflict damage against this Pokémon.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the success rate while fishing is increased.
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents being forced out of battle by other Pokémon's moves.
abilities.effectKo: 흡반으로 지면에 달라붙어 포켓몬을 교체시키는 기술이나 도구의 효과를 발휘하지 못하게 한다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 흡반으로 지면에 달라붙어 포켓몬을 교체시키는 기술이나 도구의 효과를 발휘하지 못하게 한다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 흡반으로 지면에 달라붙어 포켓몬을 교체시키는 기술이나 도구의 효과를 발휘하지 못하게 한다.

abilities.name: 위협
abilities.effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, the opponent's Attack is lowered by one stage.  In a double battle, both opponents are affected.

This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle, but will not take effect again if lost and reobtained without leaving battle.

This ability has no effect on an opponent that has a substitute.

Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.
abilities.shortEffect: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.
abilities.effectKo: 등장했을 때 위협해서 상대를 위축시켜 상대의 공격을 떨어뜨린다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 등장했을 때 위협해서 상대를 위축시켜 상대의 공격을 떨어뜨린다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 등장했을 때 위협해서 상대를 위축시켜 상대의 공격을 떨어뜨린다.

abilities.name: 그림자밟기
abilities.effect:
While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out.

Other Pokémon with this ability are unaffected.  Pokémon with run away can still flee.  Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.
abilities.effectKo: 상대의 그림자를 밟아 도망치거나 교체할 수 없게 한다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 상대의 그림자를 밟아 도망치거나 교체할 수 없게 한다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 상대의 그림자를 밟아 도망치거나 교체할 수 없게 한다.

abilities.name: 까칠한피부
abilities.effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage.

This ability functions identically to iron barbs.
abilities.shortEffect: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.
abilities.effectKo: 공격을 받았을 때 자신에게 접촉한 상대를 까칠까칠한 피부로 상처를 입힌다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 공격을 받았을 때 자신에게 접촉한 상대를 까칠까칠한 피부로 상처를 입힌다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 공격을 받았을 때 자신에게 접촉한 상대를 까칠까칠한 피부로 상처를 입힌다.

abilities.name: 불가사의부적
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon is immune to damaging moves that are not super effective against it.

Moves that inflict fixed damage, such as night shade or seismic toss, are considered super effective if their types are.  Damage not directly dealt by moves, such as damage from weather, a status ailment, or spikes, is not prevented.

This ability cannot be copied with role play or traded away with skill swap, but it can be copied with trace, disabled with gastro acid, or changed with worry seed.  This Pokémon can still use Role Play itself to lose this ability, but not Skill Swap.

If this Pokémon has a substitute, this ability will block moves as usual and any moves not blocked will react to the Substitute as usual.
abilities.shortEffect: Protects against damaging moves that are not super effective.
abilities.effectKo: 효과가 굉장한 기술만 맞는 불가사의한 힘.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 효과가 굉장한 기술만 맞는 불가사의한 힘.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 효과가 굉장한 기술만 맞는 불가사의한 힘.

abilities.name: 부유
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon is immune to ground-type moves, spikes, toxic spikes, and arena trap.

This ability is disabled during gravity or ingrain, or while holding an iron ball.  This ability is not disabled during roost.
abilities.shortEffect: Evades ground moves.
abilities.effectKo: 땅에서 뜨는 것으로 땅타입의 기술을 받지 않는다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 땅에서 뜨는 것으로 땅타입의 기술을 받지 않는다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 땅에서 뜨는 것으로 땅타입의 기술을 받지 않는다.

abilities.name: 포자
abilities.effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed, poisoned, or put to sleep, chosen at random.

Nothing is done to compensate if the move's user is immune to one of these ailments; there is simply a lower chance that the move's user will be affected.
abilities.shortEffect: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.effectKo: 공격으로 자신에게 접촉한 상대를 독이나 마비, 잠듦 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 공격으로 자신에게 접촉한 상대를 독이나 마비, 잠듦 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 공격으로 자신에게 접촉한 상대를 독이나 마비, 잠듦 상태로 만들 때가 있다.

abilities.name: 싱크로
abilities.effect:
Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment.

This ability passes back bad poison when this Pokémon is badly poisoned.  This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from toxic spikes or the burn from a flame orb.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature.  This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries.
abilities.shortEffect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.
abilities.effectKo: 자신이 걸린 독이나 마비, 화상을 상대에게 옮긴다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 자신이 걸린 독이나 마비, 화상을 상대에게 옮긴다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 자신이 걸린 독이나 마비, 화상을 상대에게 옮긴다.

abilities.name: 클리어바디
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon.

This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis.  This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through guard swap, heart swap, or power swap.

This ability functions identically to white smoke in battle.
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
abilities.effectKo: 상대 기술이나 특성으로 능력을 떨어뜨릴 수 없다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 상대 기술이나 특성으로 능력을 떨어뜨릴 수 없다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 상대 기술이나 특성으로 능력을 떨어뜨릴 수 없다.

abilities.name: 자연회복
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment when it is switched out for another Pokémon.

If this ability is acquired during battle, the Pokémon is cured upon leaving battle before losing the temporary ability.
abilities.shortEffect: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.
abilities.effectKo: 지닌 포켓몬으로 돌아오면 상태 이상이 회복된다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 지닌 포켓몬으로 돌아오면 상태 이상이 회복된다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 지닌 포켓몬으로 돌아오면 상태 이상이 회복된다.

abilities.name: 피뢰침
abilities.effect:
All other Pokémon's single-target electric-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon if it is an eligible target.  Other Pokémon's Electric moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it.

abilities.name: 모래날림

The weather changes to a sandstorm when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition.

If multiple Pokémon with this ability, drizzle, drought, or snow warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting trick room.  Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

abilities.name: 프레셔

Moves targetting this Pokémon use one extra PP.

This ability stacks if multiple targets have it.  This ability still affects moves that fail or miss.  This ability does not affect ally moves that target either the entire field or just its side, nor this Pokémon's self-targetted moves; it does, however, affect single-targetted ally moves aimed at this Pokémon, ally moves that target all other Pokémon, and opponents' moves that target the entire field. The air balloon and eject button cannot be picked up.

abilities.name: 게으름
abilities.effect:
Every second turn on which this Pokémon should attempt to use a move, it will instead do nothing ("loaf around").

Loafing around interrupts moves that take multiple turns the same way paralysis, flinching, etc do.  Most such moves, for example bide or rollout, are simply cut off upon loafing around.  Attacks with a recharge turn, such as hyper beam, do not have to recharge; attacks with a preparation turn, such as fly, do not end up being used.  Moves that are forced over multiple turns and keep going through failure, such as outrage, uproar, or any move forced by encore, keep going as usual.

If this Pokémon is confused, its confusion is not checked when loafing around; the Pokémon cannot hurt itself, and its confusion does not end or come closer to ending.

If this Pokémon attempts to move but fails, e.g. because of paralysis or gravity, it still counts as having moved and will loaf around the next turn.  If it does not attempt to move, e.g. because it is asleep or frozen, whatever it would have done will be postponed until its next attempt; that is, it will either loaf around or move as usual, depending on what it last did.

This ability cannot be changed with worry seed, but it can be disabled with gastro acid, changed with role play, or traded away with skill swap.
abilities.shortEffect: Skips every second turn.

abilities.effect: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

abilities.effect: During strong sunlight, this Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack but takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn.
abilities.shortEffect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.

abilities.effect:
Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Speed.  This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Speed cut from paralysis.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.
abilities.shortEffect: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

abilities.name: 노말스킨
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon's moves all act as if they were normal-type.

Moves that inflict typeless damage do so as usual.  Moves of variable type, such as hidden power, are affected.  They otherwise work as usual, however; weather ball, for example, is always forced to be Normal, but it still has doubled power and looks different during weather.

As thunder wave is prevented by immunities, unlike most non-damaging moves, it does not affect ghost-type Pokémon under the effect of this ability.
abilities.shortEffect: Makes the Pokémon's moves all act normal-type.
abilities.effectKo: 어떤 타입의 기술도 모두 노말타입이 된다. 위력이 조금 올라간다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 어떤 타입의 기술도 모두 노말타입이 된다. 위력이 조금 올라간다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 어떤 타입의 기술도 모두 노말타입이 된다. 위력이 조금 올라간다.

abilities.name: 스나이퍼
abilities.effect: This Pokémon inflicts triple damage with critical hits, rather than the usual double damage.
abilities.shortEffect: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.
abilities.effectKo: 공격을 급소에 맞혔을 때 위력이 더욱 올라간다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 공격을 급소에 맞혔을 때 위력이 더욱 올라간다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 공격을 급소에 맞혔을 때 위력이 더욱 올라간다.

abilities.name: 매직가드
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon is immune to damage not directly caused by a move.

For example, this Pokémon takes no damage from from weather, recoil, status ailments, or spikes, but it still suffers from the Attack cut when burned, and a life orb will still power up this Pokémon's moves without damaging it.  Anything that directly depends on such damage will also not happen; for example, leech seed will neither hurt this Pokémon nor heal the opponent, and Pokémon with a jaboca berry or rowap berry will not consume the berry when hit by this Pokémon.

The following are unaffected: struggle, pain split (whether used by or against this Pokémon), belly drum, substitute, curse, moves that knock the user out, and damage from confusion.

This Pokémon will neither lose nor regain HP if it drains HP from a Pokémon with liquid ooze.

If this Pokémon is badly poisoned, the poison counter is still increased each turn; if the Pokémon loses this ability, it will begin taking as much damage as it would be if it had been taking increasing damage each turn.
abilities.shortEffect: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.
abilities.effectKo: 공격 이외에는 데미지를 입지 않는다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 공격 이외에는 데미지를 입지 않는다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 공격 이외에는 데미지를 입지 않는다.

abilities.name: 노가드
abilities.effect:
Moves used by or against this Pokémon never miss.

One-hit KO moves are unaffected.  Moves affected by this ability can hit Pokémon during the preparation turn of moves like dig or fly.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.
abilities.shortEffect: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.
abilities.effectKo: 노가드전법에 따라 서로가 사용하는 기술이 반드시 맞게 된다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 노가드전법에 따라 서로가 사용하는 기술이 반드시 맞게 된다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 노가드전법에 따라 서로가 사용하는 기술이 반드시 맞게 된다.

abilities.name: 시간벌기
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon moves last within its priority bracket.

Multiple Pokémon with this ability move in order of Speed amongst themselves.

The full incense and lagging tail take precedence over this ability; that is, Pokémon with these items move after Pokémon with this ability.  Pokémon with both this ability and one of these items are delayed as much as if they had only the item.

This ability works as usual during trick room: Pokémon with this ability will move in reverse order of Speed after Pokémon without it.
abilities.shortEffect: Makes the Pokémon move last within its move's priority bracket.
abilities.effectKo: 기술을 사용하는 순서가 반드시 마지막이 된다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 기술을 사용하는 순서가 반드시 마지막이 된다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 기술을 사용하는 순서가 반드시 마지막이 된다.

abilities.name: 테크니션
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less.

This includes moves of variable power, such as hidden power and magnitude, when their power is 60 or less.  helping hand's power boost is taken into account for any move, as is defense curl's power boost for rollout.
abilities.shortEffect: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.
abilities.effectKo: 위력이 약한 기술의 위력을 올려서 공격할 수 있다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 위력이 약한 기술의 위력을 올려서 공격할 수 있다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 위력이 약한 기술의 위력을 올려서 공격할 수 있다.

abilities.name: 리프가드
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon cannot be given a major status ailment during strong sunlight.

This ability does not heal prior status ailments.  rest will fail altogether with this ability in effect.  yawn will immediately fail if used on this Pokémon during strong sunlight, and an already-used Yawn will fail if the weather turns to strong sunlight in the meantime.
abilities.shortEffect: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.
abilities.effectKo: 날씨가 맑을 때는 상태 이상이 되지 않는다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 날씨가 맑을 때는 상태 이상이 되지 않는다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 날씨가 맑을 때는 상태 이상이 되지 않는다.

abilities.name: 서투름
abilities.effect:
In battle, this Pokémon cannot use its held item, nor will the item have any passive effect on the battle, positive or negative.  This Pokémon also cannot use fling.

The Speed cut from the iron ball and the effort items (the macho brace, power weight, power bracer, power belt, power lens, power band, and power anklet) is unaffected.  Items that do not directly affect the battle, such as the exp share, the amulet coin, or the soothe bell, work as usual.  All held items work as usual out of battle.

Other moves that use the held item, such as natural gift and switcheroo, work as usual.
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents the Pokémon from using its held item in battle.
abilities.effectKo: 지니고 있는 도구를 쓸 수 없다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 지니고 있는 도구를 쓸 수 없다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 지니고 있는 도구를 쓸 수 없다.

abilities.name: 틀깨기
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target.

For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as water absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as clear body, shell armor, or sticky hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as simple, snow cloak, or thick fat.  If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. dry skin or unaware, the ability is ignored either way.

Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected.  For example, cursed body only affects potential future uses of the move, while liquid ooze and shadow tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user.  This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example color change or forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from drizzle.  This ability cannot ignore multitype at all.

An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used.  For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed.

When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability.

This ability functions identically to teravolt and turboblaze.
abilities.shortEffect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.
abilities.effectKo: 상대 특성에 방해받지 않고 상대에게 기술을 쓸 수 있다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 상대 특성에 방해받지 않고 상대에게 기술을 쓸 수 있다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 상대 특성에 방해받지 않고 상대에게 기술을 쓸 수 있다.

abilities.effect: This Pokémon's moves have critical hit rates one stage higher than normal.
abilities.shortEffect: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.
abilities.effectKo: 대운을 가지고 있어 상대의 급소에 공격이 맞기 쉽다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 대운을 가지고 있어 상대의 급소에 공격이 맞기 쉽다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 대운을 가지고 있어 상대의 급소에 공격이 맞기 쉽다.

abilities.name: 유폭
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon is knocked out by a move that makes contact, the move's user takes 1/4 its maximum HP in damage.
abilities.shortEffect: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.
abilities.effectKo: 기절했을 때 접촉한 상대에게 데미지를 준다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 기절했을 때 접촉한 상대에게 데미지를 준다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 기절했을 때 접촉한 상대에게 데미지를 준다.

abilities.name: 위험예지
abilities.effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, if one of its opponents has a move that is super effective against it, self destruct, explosion, or a one-hit knockout move, all participating trainers are notified.

The move itself is not revealed; only that there is such a move.  Moves that inflict typeless damage, such as future sight, and moves of variable type, such as hidden power, count as their listed types.  counter, metal burst, mirror coat, and one-hit KO moves to which this Pokémon is immune do not trigger this ability.
abilities.shortEffect: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, self destruct, explosion, or a one-hit KO move.
abilities.effectKo: 상대가 지닌 위험한 기술을 감지할 수 있다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 상대가 지닌 위험한 기술을 감지할 수 있다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 상대가 지닌 위험한 기술을 감지할 수 있다.

abilities.name: 예지몽
abilities.effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals the move with the highest base power known by any opposing Pokémon to all participating trainers.

In the event of a tie, one is chosen at random.

Moves without a listed base power are assigned one as follows:

Power | Moves
----: | -----
  160 | One-hit KO moves: fissure, guillotine, horn drill, and sheer cold
  120 | Counter moves: counter, metal burst, and mirror coat
   80 | Variable power or set damage: crush grip, dragon rage, electro ball, endeavor, final gambit, flail, frustration, grass knot, gyro ball, heat crash, heavy slam, hidden power, low kick, natural gift, night shade, psywave, return, reversal, seismic toss, sonic boom, trump card, and wring out
    0 | Any such move not listed
abilities.shortEffect: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.
abilities.effectKo: 등장했을 때 상대가 지닌 기술을 하나만 꿰뚫어본다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 등장했을 때 상대가 지닌 기술을 하나만 꿰뚫어본다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 등장했을 때 상대가 지닌 기술을 하나만 꿰뚫어본다.

abilities.name: 천진
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for the purposes of damage and accuracy calculation.

Effectively, this affects modifiers of every stat except Speed.

The power of punishment and stored power is calculated as usual.  When this Pokémon hurts itself in confusion, its stat modifiers affect damage as usual.
abilities.shortEffect: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.

abilities.effect: This Pokémon deals twice as much damage with moves that are not very effective against the target.
abilities.shortEffect: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.
abilities.effectKo: 효과가 별로인 기술을 통상의 위력으로 쓸 수 있다.

abilities.name: 슬로스타트
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon's Attack and Speed are halved for five turns upon entering battle.

This ability also takes effect when acquired during battle.  If this Pokémon loses its ability before the five turns are up, its Attack and Speed return to normal; if it then regains this ability without leaving battle, its Attack and Speed are halved again, but the counter keeps counting from where it was.
abilities.shortEffect: Halves Attack and Speed for five turns upon entering battle.
abilities.effectKo: 5턴 동안 공격과 스피드가 절반이 된다.

abilities.flavorTextKo: 5턴 동안 공격과 스피드가 절반이 된다.

abilities.name: 배짱
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon ignores ghost-type Pokémon's immunity to normal- and fighting-type moves.

Ghost Pokémon's other types affect damage as usual.
abilities.shortEffect: Lets the Pokémon's normal and fighting moves hit ghost Pokémon.
abilities.effectKo: 고스트타입 포켓몬에게 노말타입과 격투타입의 기술을 맞게 한다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 고스트타입 포켓몬에게 노말타입과 격투타입의 기술을 맞게 한다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 고스트타입 포켓몬에게 노말타입과 격투타입의 기술을 맞게 한다.

abilities.name: 마중물
abilities.effect:
All other Pokémon's single-target water-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon, if it is an eligible target.  Other Pokémon's Water moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it.

If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected.  When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon.  follow me takes precedence over this ability.
abilities.shortEffect: Redirects single-target water moves to this Pokémon where possible.  Absorbs Water moves, raising Special Attack one stage.
abilities.effectKo: 물타입의 기술을 자신에게 끌어모아 데미지는 받지 않고 특수공격이 올라간다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 물타입의 기술을 자신에게 끌어모아 데미지는 받지 않고 특수공격이 올라간다.

abilities.effect: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during snow, and it does not take snow damage regardless of type.
abilities.shortEffect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during snow.  Protects against snow damage.

abilities.effect:
The weather changes to snow when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition.

If multiple Pokémon with this ability, drizzle, drought, or sand stream are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting trick room.  Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
abilities.shortEffect: Summons snow that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
abilities.effectKo: 등장했을 때 날씨를 설경으로 만든다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 등장했을 때 날씨를 설경으로 만든다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 등장했을 때 날씨를 설경으로 만든다.

abilities.name: 꿀모으기
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon has a chance of picking up honey after each battle.  This chance starts at 5% and rises another 5% after every tenth level: 5% from level 1–10, 10% from 11–20, and so on, up to 50% from 91–100.

This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.
abilities.shortEffect: The Pokémon may pick up honey after battle.
abilities.effectKo: 배틀이 끝났을 때 달콤한꿀을 주울 때가 있다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 배틀이 끝났을 때 달콤한꿀을 주울 때가 있다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 배틀이 끝났을 때 달콤한꿀을 주울 때가 있다.

abilities.name: 통찰
abilities.effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals an opposing Pokémon's held item to all participating trainers.

In a double battle, if one opponent has an item, this Pokémon will Frisk that Pokémon; if both have an item, it will Frisk one at random.
abilities.shortEffect: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.
abilities.effectKo: 등장했을 때 상대의 지닌 물건을 통찰할 수 있다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 등장했을 때 상대의 지닌 물건을 통찰할 수 있다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 등장했을 때 상대의 지닌 물건을 통찰할 수 있다.

abilities.name: 이판사판
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon's recoil moves and crash moves have 1.2× their base power.

struggle is unaffected.

The "crash moves" are the moves that damage the user upon missing: jump kick and high jump kick.
abilities.shortEffect: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.
abilities.effectKo: 반동 데미지를 받는 기술의 위력이 올라간다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 반동 데미지를 받는 기술의 위력이 올라간다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 반동 데미지를 받는 기술의 위력이 올라간다.

abilities.name: 멀티타입
abilities.effect:
If this Pokémon is holding an elemental Plate, its type and form change to match the Plate.

This Pokémon's held item, whether or not it is a Plate, cannot be taken by covet or thief, nor removed by knock off, nor traded by switcheroo or trick.  Covet, Thief, and Knock Off still inflict damage against this Pokémon.  Unlike with sticky hold, this Pokémon cannot use fling, Switcheroo, or Trick to lose its item itself, nor gain an item through Switcheroo or Trick if it does not have one.

This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than arceus.  This ability cannot be traded with skill swap, nor copied with role play or trace, nor disabled with gastro acid, nor changed with worry seed.  This Pokémon cannot use Skill Swap or Role Play to lose its ability itself.  mold breaker cannot ignore this ability.

If a Pokémon Transforms into an Arceus with this ability, it will Transform into Arceus's default, normal-type form.  If the Transforming Pokémon is holding a Plate, this ability will then activate and change the Pokémon into the corresponding form.
abilities.shortEffect: Changes arceus's type and form to match its held Plate.
abilities.effectKo: 지니고 있는 플레이트나 Z크리스탈 타입에 따라 자신의 타입이 바뀐다.
abilities.shortEffectKo: 지니고 있는 플레이트나 Z크리스탈 타입에 따라 자신의 타입이 바뀐다.
abilities.flavorTextKo: 지니고 있는 플레이트나 Z크리스탈 타입에 따라 자신의 타입이 바뀐다.

abilities.name: 나쁜손버릇

Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, if it does not have a held item, it steals the attacker's held item.

abilities.name: 우격다짐
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon's moves with extra effects have 1.3× their power, but lose their extra effects.

An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, thunder shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but thunder wave's is not, nor are knock off's item removal and air cutter's increased critical hit rate.

abilities.shortEffect: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.

abilities.name: 심술꾸러기
abilities.effect: Whenever this Pokémon's stats would be raised, they are instead lowered by the same amount, and vice versa.

abilities.effectKo: 능력의 변화가 역전해서 올라갈 때 떨어지고 떨어질 때 올라간다.

abilities.shortEffect: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.
abilities.effectKo: 상대를 긴장시켜 나무열매를 먹지 못하게 한다.

abilities.shortEffect: Takes the appearance of the last conscious party Pokémon upon being sent out until hit by a damaging move.
abilities.effectKo: 지닌 포켓몬 중 제일 뒤에 있는 포켓몬으로 둔갑하여 나와서 상대를 속인다.

abilities.name: 터보블레이즈
abilities.effect:
This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target.

For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as water absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as clear body, shell armor, or sticky hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as simple, snow cloak, or thick fat.  If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. dry skin or unaware, the ability is ignored either way.

Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected.  For example, cursed body only affects potential future uses of the move, while liquid ooze and shadow tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user.  This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example color change or forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from drizzle.  This ability cannot ignore multitype at all.

An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used.  For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed.

When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability.

This ability functions identically to mold breaker and teravolt.

abilities.name: 기묘한약
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.
abilities.shortEffect: Resets all stat changes upon entering battlefield.
abilities.effectKo: 등장했을 때 조개껍질에서 약을 흩뿌려서 능력 변화를 원래대로 되돌린다.

abilities.effect: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.
abilities.shortEffect: Boosts Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.
abilities.effectKo: 상대를 쓰러뜨리면 차가운 울음소리를 내면서 공격이 올라간다.

abilities.name: 흑의울음
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.
abilities.shortEffect: Boosts Special Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.
abilities.effectKo: 상대를 쓰러뜨리면 무서운 울음소리를 내면서 특수공격이 올라간다.

abilities.shortEffectKo: 버드렉스의 긴장감과 블리자포스의 백의울음 두 가지 특성을 겸비한다.

abilities.effectKo: 버드렉스의 긴장감과 레이스포스의 흑의울음 두 가지 특성을 겸비한다.

abilities.name: Lingering Aroma
abilities.effect: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Lingering Aroma.
abilities.shortEffect: Contact changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

abilities.name: Seed Sower
abilities.effect: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
abilities.shortEffect: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

abilities.name: Thermal Exchange
abilities.effect: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
abilities.shortEffect: Raises Attack when hit by a Fire-type move. Cannot be burned.

abilities.name: Anger Shell
abilities.effect: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
abilities.shortEffect: When the Pokémon's HP drops below half, Anger Shell lowers its Defense and Special Defense but its Attack, Special Attack and Speed are raised.

abilities.name: Purifying Salt
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
abilities.shortEffect: Protects from status conditions and halves damage from Ghost-type moves.

abilities.name: Well-Baked Body
abilities.effect: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.
abilities.shortEffect: Immune to Fire-type moves, and Defense is sharply boosted.

abilities.name: Wind Rider
abilities.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
abilities.shortEffect: Gives immunity to wind moves, and causes the Pokémon's Attack to increase by one stage when hit by one.

abilities.name: Guard Dog
abilities.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.
abilities.shortEffect: Boosts Attack if intimidated, and prevents being forced to switch out.

abilities.name: Rocky Payload
abilities.effect: Increases the power of Rock-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.
abilities.shortEffect: Powers up Rock-type moves.

abilities.name: Wind Power
abilities.effect: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
abilities.shortEffect: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.

abilities.name: Zero to Hero
abilities.effect: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
abilities.shortEffect: Transforms into its Hero Form when switching out.

abilities.name: Commander
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.
abilities.shortEffect: Goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field.

abilities.name: Electromorphosis
abilities.effect: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
abilities.shortEffect: When hit by an attack, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.

abilities.name: Protosynthesis
abilities.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
abilities.shortEffect: Raises highest stat in harsh sunlight, or if holding Booster Energy.

abilities.name: Quark Drive
abilities.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
abilities.shortEffect: Raises highest stat on Electric Terrain, or if holding Booster Energy.

abilities.name: Good as Gold
abilities.effect: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon’s status moves.
abilities.shortEffect: Gives immunity to status moves.

abilities.name: Vessel of Ruin
abilities.effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.shortEffect: Lowers Special Attack of all Pokémon except itself.

abilities.name: Sword of Ruin
abilities.effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.shortEffect: Lowers Defense of all Pokémon except itself.

abilities.name: Tablets of Ruin
abilities.effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.shortEffect: Lowers Attack of all Pokémon except itself.

abilities.name: Beads of Ruin
abilities.effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.
abilities.shortEffect: Lowers Special Defense of all Pokémon except itself.

abilities.name: Orichalcum Pulse
abilities.effect: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.
abilities.shortEffect: Turns the sunlight harsh when entering battle, and boosts Attack while active.

abilities.name: Hadron Engine
abilities.effect: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.
abilities.shortEffect: Creates an Electric Terrain when entering battle, and boosts Special Attack while active.

abilities.name: Opportunist
abilities.effect: If an opponent’s stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
abilities.shortEffect: Copies stat boosts by the opponent.

abilities.name: Cud Chew
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.
abilities.shortEffect: Causes the Pokémon to reuse an already consumed Berry at the end of the next turn.

abilities.name: Sharpness
abilities.effect: Increases the power of all 'slicing' moves by 50%.
abilities.shortEffect: Powers up slicing moves.

abilities.name: Supreme Overlord
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
abilities.shortEffect: Attack and Special Attack are boosted for each party Pokémon that has been defeated.

abilities.name: Costar
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally’s stat changes.
abilities.shortEffect: Copies ally's stat changes on entering battle.

abilities.name: Toxic Debris
abilities.effect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
abilities.shortEffect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

abilities.name: Armor Tail
abilities.effect: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon’s head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
abilities.shortEffect: Prevents the opponent from using any moves that have priority, such as Quick Attack.

abilities.name: Earth Eater
abilities.effect: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
abilities.shortEffect: Restores HP when hit by a Ground-type move.

abilities.name: Mycelium Might
abilities.effect: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
abilities.shortEffect: Status moves go last, but are not affected by the opponent's ability.

abilities.name: 심안
abilities.effect: Mind's Eye enables the Pokémon with this Ability to hit Ghost-type Pokémon with damage-dealing Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It also prevents other Pokémon from lowering the Pokémon's accuracy and ignores changes to the opponents' evasion.
abilities.shortEffect: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

abilities.name: 감미로운꿀
abilities.effect: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field the first time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.
abilities.shortEffect: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.

abilities.name: 대접
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.
abilities.shortEffect: When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.

abilities.name: 독사슬
abilities.effect: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move.
abilities.shortEffect: May cause bad poisoning when the Pokémon hits an opponent with a move.

abilities.name: 초상투영
abilities.effect: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon
abilities.shortEffect: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon

abilities.name: 테라체인지
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
abilities.shortEffect: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.

abilities.name: 테라셸
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
abilities.shortEffect: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

abilities.name: 제로포밍
abilities.effect: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.
abilities.shortEffect: As soon as Terapagos assumes its Stellar Form, it will immediately neutralize weather and terrain effects.

abilities.name: 독조종
abilities.effect: When a Pokémon is poisoned by any of Pecharunt's moves, it will also become confused.
abilities.shortEffect: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
